faq_heading: Oxford Heights houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Oxford Heights. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Oxford Heights, Port Coquitlam: 13 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 3 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 23%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. By listings that is number 4 of 10 Port Coquitlam communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Port Coquitlam total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Oxford Heights fell from 19 in June to 13 in October (−31.6%), and 13 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 9.5% of Port Coquitlam’s 137 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Oxford Heights?
Oxford Heights also had 2 condos and townhomes listed and 0 sold in October, against 13 houses listed.

blocks.text: Oxford Heights home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

24 houses sold in Oxford Heights with a median price of $1,269,000 (the middle half sold between $1,126,250 and $1,399,250), taking a median of 30 days to sell at 96.4% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $590 per square foot, a median year built of 1975 and a median lot of 6,639 square feet.

blocks.source: Source: Paragon, the MLS® system used by Jared’s office, closed sales from November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026. Pending sales are not counted. Median means the middle price, so half sold for more and half for less. Sold vs list is the sale price as a percentage of the last list price. A figure is shown only where at least 5 homes sold, and a row is shown only with 5 or more sales; with fewer, one sale would be the whole figure.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Oxford Heights?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® figures showed 13 houses listed in Oxford Heights. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Oxford Heights a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Oxford Heights had a sales ratio of 23%, which the reports’ scale reads as a sellers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Oxford Heights from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 13 houses sold in Oxford Heights over those 5 months, out of 91 in all of Port Coquitlam.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Oxford Heights?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Oxford Heights sell for?
faq.a: 24 houses sold in Oxford Heights between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,269,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Oxford Heights?
faq.a: The median was 30 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.4% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
